title: Quality Director – Aerospace & Defense
text:
A designer and manufacturer of advanced defense systems in Columbus, MS is hiring a Quality Director to lead its quality management system. You'll sit on the site's senior leadership team, with the visibility of a smaller company and the backing of a large global parent.

What you'll do:

* Lead the quality management system and maintain AS9100 and Nadcap certifications
* Lead, train and develop the quality team
* Set, track and report quality KPIs to leadership
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective/preventive actions
* Respond to customer quality concerns and manage supplier quality
* Lead internal, customer, supplier and certification audits
* Partner with management on site-wide quality initiatives

What you'll bring:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* Quality management experience in manufacturing, ideally aerospace or defense
* Proven supervisory and leadership experience
* Experience leading AS9100 / ISO certifications; Nadcap audit experience strongly preferred
* Strong root cause, metrics and continuous improvement background
* Ability to travel occasionally, including out of state and internationally
* Must be a U.S. person under export control rules

Pay: $150,000.00 - $170,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many people have reported to you in a quality leadership role?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Quality management: 5 years (Required)
* AS9100: 3 years (Required)

License/Certification:

* AS9100 Lead Auditor (Required)

Work Location: In person
